_comment: One entry per funded project. 'funder_group' must be one of: EU, DFG, German ministries, TUM IGSSE, DAAD, Other. 'status' is computed from 'end' by the site; set 'status' only to override. Budgets are TUM share in EUR unless 'budget_scope' says 'consortium'.

projects.name: i-TRAUM
projects.full_name: Intelligent Traffic Risk Assessment with User Monitoring
projects.summary: Online, context-aware crash risk estimation that learns adaptive risk thresholds from individual driving behaviour in real time.

projects.name: AgiMo
projects.full_name: Data-driven agile planning for responsible mobility
projects.summary: CRC between TUM, TU Dresden, TU Berlin, TU Braunschweig and DLR on data-driven methods and a digital twin for responsible mobility planning.

projects.name: PROMETHEUS
projects.full_name: Predictive Resilience and Optimization Methods for Emergency Transportation Handling and Enhanced Urban Stability
projects.summary: Rapid response to transportation network disruption, combining anomaly detection with sparse nonlinear methods such as SINDy.

projects.name: SEE-FAr
projects.full_name: Shaping E-Roads Efficiency for Freight Automation
projects.summary: Electrification and automation of freight transport, comparing stationary and in-motion (electric road) charging.

projects.name: SCUDO
projects.full_name: Safe and Comprehensive Urban Development and Transport Management for Disruption-Resilient Operations
projects.summary: Safer, more resilient, energy-efficient transport across Europe using AI-based forecasting, monitoring and decision support.

projects.name: VOTAVI
projects.full_name: Value of Time estimation considering Automated Vehicle Impacts
projects.summary: A smartphone app combining revealed and stated preference surveys to re-examine the value of travel time for the autonomous vehicle era.

projects.name: MI-TRAP
projects.summary: Bottom-up dose-response framework quantifying environmental and health impacts of transport pollution in Copenhagen, Milan and Zurich.

projects.name: AUTOSUP
projects.full_name: Preparing the ground for AUTOnomous multimodal SUPply chains
projects.summary: Multimodal automatic freight transport concepts for hubs in a Physical Internet logistics network, with digital twins and an open decision support system.

projects.name: CulturalRoad
projects.full_name: Cultural, regional and societal factors to overcome barriers to connected, cooperative and automated mobility deployment
projects.summary: Guidelines for CCAM deployment that account for cultural, regional and legal diversity across countries.

projects.name: ATHLOS
projects.full_name: Autonomous Transport for Harmonised Low-Carbon Operations and Sustainability
projects.summary: Interventions to minimise urban transport emissions combining advanced traffic management with connected and autonomous vehicles; London and Munich case networks.

projects.name: MINDMAP
projects.full_name: Model Interpretation and Data-centric Modeling for Advanced traffic Prediction
projects.summary: Data-efficient, interpretable methods for transferring graph neural network traffic prediction models to new datasets and study areas.

projects.name: MODA
projects.summary: Travel mode detection from the data and modelling sides, with a simulation test bed and an opportunistic data collection framework.

projects.name: PHOEBE
projects.summary: Predictive approaches for safer urban environments.

projects.name: AMI-AirShuttle
projects.funder: Bavarian Ministry of Economic Affairs, Regional Development and Energy

projects.funder: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research

projects.funder: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research

projects.funder: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research

projects.funder: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action

projects.name: Drive2theFuture
projects.summary: How people come to accept automated vehicles.

projects.name: MOMENTUM
projects.summary: City transport models for shared, on-demand and automated services.

projects.name: i-DREAMS
projects.summary: Driver monitoring and real-time safety interventions; one of the largest naturalistic driving data collections.
